recipe.visualDefinition: A vertically and horizontally mirrored photograph of industrial piping and refinery structures, creating a central diamond-shaped focal point of converging lines, overlaid with high-contrast orange sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical reflection creates a kaleidoscopic geometric pattern from organic industrial forms.
Complementary color contrast between cool blue-grey steel and vibrant orange text.
Horizontal text blocks anchored to the top-left quadrant against the complex background.
coreInvariants: Perfect vertical and horizontal axis symmetry.
High-saturation orange for all graphic and typographic elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The industrial structure is centered and fills the entire frame, creating a sense of infinite repetition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central 'eye' or diamond shape formed by the meeting of mirrored pipe curves.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the leading lines of the pipes from the corners toward the center, then jumps to the high-contrast text in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with mechanical detail, using the sky as a muted backdrop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool grey and slate blue (industrial steel and sky).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation background with high-value highlights, contrasted by a flat, high-saturation foreground color.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter spacing (tracking) to create a solid block of color
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all text to maintain industrial uniformity.
graphicDevices: Abstract geometric icon (trapezoidal/hexagonal) placed to the left of the text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 80s industrial/technological aesthetic and wide proportions.
Similar geometric structure and square-off curves.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of industrial refinery pipes and steel structures under a clear sky. Apply a four-way mirror effect (vertical and horizontal) so the pipes converge into a central diamond-shaped geometric pattern. The color palette should be dominated by cool metallic greys and blues.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase text in the top-left quadrant using a bold, extended geometric sans-serif font. The text must be a vibrant safety orange. Include a small, solid orange geometric icon to the left of the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the symmetry perfect across both axes?
Is the text color a high-contrast orange?
Are the fonts wide and bold sans-serifs?
Does the central pattern form a clear geometric 'eye'?

adjustableVariables: Specific geometric shape of the icon
mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is mirrored/backwards in the background image.
Check that the orange text is fully opaque.
Verify the central diamond shape is centered in the frame.
Confirm the font is extended width.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Symmetry + Geometric Sans + High-Contrast Complementary Palette
